name: nezha-active-pat-connection-inventory-and-7f4d
instr:
Coder cannot currently inventory active PAT-backed work or terminate selected connections without deleting the PAT. Build that inventory for maintainers and token owners, unifying consumer lifecycles behind stable identities while preserving authorization, full revocation, JWT behavior, and established cleanup and response semantics.

Every PAT registration gets a stable nonzero ID and exposes its token, kind, optional server, resource, method, and tool metadata. `PATConnectionKind` has `PATConnectionTerminal = "terminal"`, `PATConnectionFileManager = "file_manager"`, `PATConnectionMCP = "mcp"`, `PATConnectionTransfer = "transfer"`, and `PATConnectionServerStream = "server_stream"`.

The model package exports `PATConnectionRegistration(TokenID, Kind, ServerID, ResourceID, Method, ToolName, Cancel)`, `PATConnection(ID, TokenID, Kind, ServerID, ResourceID, Method, ToolName)`, `PATConnectionFilter(TokenID, ID, Kind, ServerID)`, `PATConnectionSnapshot(Connections)`, and `PATConnectionTerminationReport(Terminated)` with the contracted JSON field names and omissions. Combine supplied filter fields conjunctively and leave omitted fields unrestricted. Snapshots are immutable point-in-time copies ordered by ID.
